title: Build Generator<int> from Scratch
prompt: Implement the full `Generator<T>` from the lesson (promise, handle wrapper, RAII) and the `counter(from, to)` coroutine with `co_yield`. The graded checks resume it exactly and expect exact values.

tests.name: counter yields an inclusive range
tests.hint: for (int i = from; i <= to; ++i) co_yield i; — with from > to the loop never runs and every next() returns false.

tests.name: empty range is truly empty
tests.hint: The body runs once (resume), the for-condition fails immediately, final_suspend pauses, done() is true — no value ever stored.

tests.name: two generators do not interfere
tests.hint: Each coroutine has its own frame and promise — frames are independent by construction.
